summary: Traced the logged failures to six root causes (shared settings defaults, local-timezone today(), set-ordered bin tie-break, shared CSV spool file, rate cache key missing zones/fuel/bands, month-end review date), fixed them in stockroom/ and wrote flaky-report.json. Also hardened a few related spots (float billable weight, regexes, ledger transfer qty, review_day validation); the full suite passes under shuffled/reverse/sorted orders, several timezones and month-end clocks. The 2.6.0-only unit-conversion failures and the two cancelled runs are not current defects and have no entry.
